  rows = [ONLY(crm-[c:Companies WHERE c.`Name` == "Acme"]->)]
  answer = await FIRST(AT(rows, 0)-[r:Founders]->)
}

diagnostics.message: 'await' parks on the record it waits at, and a parked run finds that record again by NAME — so this one is bound first: 'waiting = AT(rows, 0)', then 'await FIRST(waiting-[r:Founders]->)'.
'FIRST(AT(rows, 0)-[r:Founders]->)' can't be awaited — 'await' waits on an edge whose resolution resumes the run (an ask's Response). This is an ordinary edge; read it live, without 'await'.

import { attio, ledger } from adapters
import { crm_cred, ledger_cred } from credentials
import { summarise, relay, tag, ocr } from plugins

crm = attio(credentials: crm_cred)
l = ledger(credentials: ledger_cred)
movement m() {
  f = FILE("contents", "pdf")
  s = ocr(doc: f)
}

  f = FILE("contents", "pdf")
  s = ocr(doc: { a: f })
}

import { attio, slack, trello } from adapters
import { probe } from credentials

crm = attio(credentials: probe)
chat = slack(credentials: probe)
board = trello(credentials: probe)
movement main(evt: <crm-[:`Webhook Event`]->>) {
  fallback = "unknown"
  n = COALESCE(ONLY(chat-[c:Channels]->.`Name`), fallback)
  write board-[:Lanes]-> { Title: n }
}
listen to crm { events: ["record.created"] } fire main

import { dealflow_inbox, acme_main, acme_workspace, acme_affinity, team_drive, team_chat, native_knowledge } from credentials
import { scrub_sensitive, vc_url_retrieval } from plugins

inbox = email(credentials: dealflow_inbox)
crm   = attio(credentials: acme_main)
team  = slack(credentials: acme_workspace)
aff   = affinity(credentials: acme_affinity)
drive = dropbox(credentials: team_drive)
chan  = messaging(credentials: team_chat)
graph = kg(credentials: native_knowledge)
movement main(msg: <inbox-[:message]->>) {
  write graph-[:contact]-> {
    name: msg.`subject`
    email ?: DATE.PARSE(msg.`subject`)
  }
}

diagnostics.message: 'main' has no listener, so nothing dispatches it — add a listen statement, e.g. listen to inbox fire main

import { attio, slack, trello } from adapters
import { probe } from credentials

crm = attio(credentials: probe)
chat = slack(credentials: probe)
board = trello(credentials: probe)
movement main(evt: <crm-[:`Webhook Event`]->>) {
  fallback = "unknown"
  n = COALESCE(ONLY(chat-[c:Channels]->.`Name`), fallback)
  write board-[:Lanes]-> { Title: n }
}
listen to crm { events: ["record.created"] } fire main

import { email, attio } from adapters
import { dealflow_inbox, acme_main } from credentials

inbox = email(credentials: dealflow_inbox)
crm   = attio(credentials: acme_main)
type Thesis = <"Consumer" | "Infra">
rules = "route infra to Infra"
import { record_deal } from "lib/deals"
movement m(msg: <inbox-[:message]->>) {
  record_deal(d: node { name: msg.`subject`, stage: "Seed" })
}

import { dealflow_inbox, acme_main, acme_workspace, acme_affinity, team_drive, team_chat, native_knowledge } from credentials
import { scrub_sensitive, vc_url_retrieval } from plugins

inbox = email(credentials: dealflow_inbox)
crm   = attio(credentials: acme_main)
team  = slack(credentials: acme_workspace)
aff   = affinity(credentials: acme_affinity)
drive = dropbox(credentials: team_drive)
chan  = messaging(credentials: team_chat)
graph = kg(credentials: native_knowledge)
movement main(msg: <inbox-[:message]->>) {
  co = write graph-[:companies]-> { unique by (`name`), name: msg.`subject` }
  link co -[:rounds]-> { ghost: "Seed" }
}

diagnostics.message: graph.funding_round has no field 'ghost' — a match's fields are fields of the record it finds; it has: stage, amount
'main' has no listener, so nothing dispatches it — add a listen statement, e.g. listen to inbox fire main

import { dealflow_inbox, acme_main, acme_workspace, acme_affinity, team_drive, team_chat, native_knowledge } from credentials
import { scrub_sensitive, vc_url_retrieval } from plugins

inbox = email(credentials: dealflow_inbox)
crm   = attio(credentials: acme_main)
team  = slack(credentials: acme_workspace)
aff   = affinity(credentials: acme_affinity)
drive = dropbox(credentials: team_drive)
chan  = messaging(credentials: team_chat)
graph = kg(credentials: native_knowledge)
movement main(msg: <inbox-[:message]->>) {
  write graph-[:contact]-> {
    name: msg.`subject`
    email: msg.`subject`
    note: AI("a note", "thourough")
  }
}

diagnostics.message: "thourough" isn't a tier — expected one of: "quick" | "careful" | "thorough". Did you mean "thorough"?
'main' has no listener, so nothing dispatches it — add a listen statement, e.g. listen to inbox fire main

import { attio, email } from adapters
crm = attio()
inbox = email()

movement m(msg: <inbox-[:message]->>) {
  rows = [ONLY(crm-[c:Companies WHERE c.`Name` == "Acme"]->)]
  answer = await FIRST(AT(rows, 0)-[r:Founders]->)
}

diagnostics.message: 'await' parks on the record it waits at, and a parked run finds that record again by NAME — so this one is bound first: 'waiting = AT(rows, 0)', then 'await FIRST(waiting-[r:Founders]->)'.

chat = slack(credentials: probe)

}

import { email, attio } from adapters
import { dealflow_inbox, acme_main } from credentials
inbox = email(credentials: dealflow_inbox)
crm   = attio(credentials: acme_main)
import { fetch_url as fetch } from plugins
type Stage = <"lead" | "won">
rules = "route infra"
node Lead: "a lead" {
  name: <text> "its name. ${rules}"
  stage: <Stage>
}
tag = "${UPPER(rules)}!"
movement m(msg: <inbox-[:message]->>) {
  label = "${msg.`subject`} ${tag}"
  await sleep(30s)
  write crm-[:companies]-> { name: label, stage: rules }
}

import { slack } from adapters
type Verdict = <"yes" | "no">
chat = slack()

movement m(c: <chat-[:channel]->>) {
  n = FIRST(COLLECT(c-[p:Members]->.`Age`))

}

import { attio, email } from adapters
crm = attio()
inbox = email()

movement m(msg: <inbox-[:message]->>) {
  rows = [ONLY(crm-[c:Companies WHERE c.`Name` == "Acme"]->)]
  answer = await FIRST(AT(rows, 0)-[r:Founders]->)
}

diagnostics.message: 'await' parks on the record it waits at, and a parked run finds that record again by NAME — so this one is bound first: 'waiting = AT(rows, 0)', then 'await FIRST(waiting-[r:Founders]->)'.

import { attio, slack, trello } from adapters
import { probe } from credentials

crm = attio(credentials: probe)
chat = slack(credentials: probe)
board = trello(credentials: probe)
movement main(evt: <crm-[:`Webhook Event`]->>) {
  n = ONLY(chat-[c:Channels]->.`Name`)
  line = IF 1 == 1 THEN n ELSE "" END
  write board-[:Lanes]-> { Title: line }
}
listen to crm { events: ["record.created"] } fire main

import { email } from adapters
import { `Dealflow Inbox` } from credentials
inbox = email(credentials: `Dealflow Inbox`)
movement m(msg: <inbox-[:message]->>) {
  words = SPLIT(msg.`text`, " ")
  loud = MAP(words, { concurrency: 2 }, (w) => UPPER(w))
  total = REDUCE(words, 0, (a: <number>, w: <text>) => a + LENGTH(w))
  kept = FILTER(loud, (w) => w != "A")
  ranked = SORT(kept, DESC)
  groups = GROUPBY(words, (w) => "${LENGTH(w)}")
  write inbox-[:note]-> { body: "${JOIN(ranked, ",")}|${AT(SORT(words), 0)}|${total}|${COUNT(groups)}" }
}

import { email, attio } from adapters
import { acme_main } from credentials
import { fetch_url } from plugins

inbox = email()
crm = attio(credentials: acme_main)
movement intake(m: <inbox-[:message]->>) {
  await parallel([
    () => { write crm-[:companies]-> { unique by (`name`), name: "Acme", summary: "left" } },
    () => { write crm-[:companies]-> { unique by (`name`), name: "Acme", summary: "right" } },
    () => { write crm-[:companies]-> { unique by (`name`), name: "Acme", summary: "third" } },
  ])
}

import { email, attio } from adapters
import { acme_main } from credentials
import { fetch_url } from plugins

inbox = email()
crm = attio(credentials: acme_main)
movement intake(m: <inbox-[:message]->>) {
  files = COLLECT(m-[:files]->.data)
  content = [m.`subject`, ...files]
  await sleep(1h)
  write crm-[:companies]-> { name: COALESCE(READ(AT(content, 1)), "unread"), summary: COALESCE(READ(ONLY(files)), "unread") }
}

import { dealflow_inbox, acme_main, acme_workspace, acme_affinity, team_drive, team_chat, native_knowledge } from credentials
import { scrub_sensitive, vc_url_retrieval } from plugins

inbox = email(credentials: dealflow_inbox)
crm   = attio(credentials: acme_main)
team  = slack(credentials: acme_workspace)
aff   = affinity(credentials: acme_affinity)
drive = dropbox(credentials: team_drive)
chan  = messaging(credentials: team_chat)
graph = kg(credentials: native_knowledge)
movement main(msg: <inbox-[:message]->>) {
  co = write graph-[:companies]-> { name: "Acme" }
  write co-[:rounds]-> { stage: "Seed" }
}

diagnostics.message: 'main' has no listener, so nothing dispatches it — add a listen statement, e.g. listen to inbox fire main

import { dealflow_inbox, acme_main, acme_workspace, acme_affinity, team_drive, team_chat, native_knowledge } from credentials
import { scrub_sensitive, vc_url_retrieval } from plugins

inbox = email(credentials: dealflow_inbox)
crm   = attio(credentials: acme_main)
team  = slack(credentials: acme_workspace)
aff   = affinity(credentials: acme_affinity)
drive = dropbox(credentials: team_drive)
chan  = messaging(credentials: team_chat)
graph = kg(credentials: native_knowledge)
movement main(msg: <inbox-[:message]->>) {
  write crm-[:companies]-> { nam: "Acme" }
}

diagnostics.message: crm.company has no field 'nam' — it has: name, domains, funding_stage
'main' has no listener, so nothing dispatches it — add a listen statement, e.g. listen to inbox fire main

import { slack } from adapters
type Verdict = <"yes" | "no">
chat = slack()

movement m(c: <chat-[:channel]->>) {
  n = FIRST(COLLECT(c-[p:Members]->.`Age`))
  big = n > 3
}

diagnostics.message: FIRST takes the first of a sequence, and 'Members' comes back in no particular order — so there is no first. If you mean the one that matched, write ONLY(…) — it answers that one and fails the run if there turns out to be more than one. Order the traversal it came from, or reach for a relationship the source keeps in order.

import { `@lf/email` as email } from adapters
import { `Dealflow Inbox` } from credentials
inbox = connect email using `Dealflow Inbox`
function m(msg: <inbox-[:message]->>) {
  words = Text.split(msg.`text`, " ")
  loud = map(words, (w) => Text.upper(w), { concurrency: 2 })
  total = reduce(words, (a: <number>, w: <text>) => a + Text.length(w), 0)
  kept = filter(loud, (w) => w != "A")
  ranked = sort(kept, { order: "desc" })
  groups = List.groupBy(words, (w) => "${Text.length(w)}")
  write inbox-[:note]-> { body: "${Text.join(ranked, ",")}|${sort(words)[0]}|${total}|${count(groups)}" }
}

the extraction keyword ('extract from […] { … }') is retired — an extraction is the call over a declared node shape: 'extract(content, Shape)' for each record the content holds, 'extractOne(content, Shape)' for the one it describes. The fix declares this tree as 'node DShape' and writes 'd = extractOne(content, DShape)': the one record the keyword's result was, its fields read off it and its nodes walked from it as before. the extraction keyword ('extract from […] { … }') is retired — an extraction is the call over a declared node shape: 'extract(content, Shape)' for each record the content holds, 'extractOne(content, Shape)' for the one it describes. The fix declares this tree as 'node DShape' and writes 'd = extractOne(content, DShape)': the one record the keyword's result was, its fields read off it and its nodes walked from it as before. Review it before applying: the record may be absent where the keyword's result never was (a field read off it then needs a fallback), an untyped field becomes <text>, and the model is asked through the call's prompt (see handbook: front#extraction)

import { crm_cred, ledger_cred } from credentials
import { summarise, relay, tag, ocr } from plugins

crm = attio(credentials: crm_cred)
l = ledger(credentials: ledger_cred)
movement m() {
  f = FILE("contents", "pdf")
  s = ocr(doc: f)
}

import { attio, ledger } from adapters
import { crm_cred, ledger_cred } from credentials
import { summarise, relay, tag, ocr } from plugins

crm = attio(credentials: crm_cred)
l = ledger(credentials: ledger_cred)
movement m() {
  org = write crm-[:companies]-> { name: "Acme Inc." }
  f = FILE("contents", "pdf")
  c = (): <text> => COALESCE(org, "x")
  s = c() = "x"
  t = IF c() = "x" THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
}

diagnostics.message: the closure 'c' declares it returns <text>, but this may be a crm.company handle — a record, not a value. A call is typed by what it declares, so return a field off it ('r.`Name`')

import { summarise, relay, tag, ocr } from plugins

l = connect ledger using ledger_cred
function m() {
  org = write crm-[:companies]-> { name: "Acme Inc." }
  f = File.from("contents", "pdf")
  h0 = () => coalesce(org, "x")
  h1 = () => [h0(), h0(), h0()]
  h2 = () => [h1(), h1(), h1()]
  h3 = () => [h2(), h2(), h2()]
  h4 = () => [h3(), h3(), h3()]
  h5 = () => [h4(), h4(), h4()]
  h6 = () => [h5(), h5(), h5()]
  h7 = () => [h6(), h6(), h6()]
  h8 = () => [h7(), h7(), h7()]
  h9 = () => [h8(), h8(), h8()]
  h10 = () => [h9(), h9(), h9()]
  h11 = () => [h10(), h10(), h10()]
  h12 = () => [h11(), h11(), h11()]
  g = graph { n: h12() }
}

import { probe } from credentials

crm = connect attio using probe
chat = connect slack using probe
board = connect trello using probe
function main(evt: <crm-[:`Webhook Event`]->>) {
  n = only(chat-[c:Channels]->.`Name`)

  write board-[:Lanes]-> { Title: line }
}
listen to crm { events: ["record.created"] } fire main

import { probe } from credentials
graph = connect crm using probe
type Thesis = <"Consumer" | "Infra" | "Health">

function main(msg: <graph-[:message]->>) {
  Thesis = msg.`Body`
}

import { email } from adapters
import { `Dealflow Inbox` } from credentials
inbox = connect email using `Dealflow Inbox`
function m(msg: <inbox-[:message]->>) {
  words = Text.split(msg.`text`, " ")
  loud = map(words, (w) => Text.upper(w), { concurrency: 2 })
  total = reduce(words, (a: <number>, w: <text>) => a + Text.length(w), 0)
  kept = filter(loud, (w) => w != "A")
  ranked = sort(kept, { order: "desc" })
  groups = List.groupBy(words, (w) => "${Text.length(w)}")
  write inbox-[:note]-> { body: "${Text.join(ranked, ",")}|${sort(words)[0]}|${total}|${count(groups)}" }
}

  total = REDUCE(words, 0, (a: <number>, w: <text>) => a + LENGTH(w))

  ranked = SORT(kept, DESC)
  groups = GROUPBY(words, (w) => "${LENGTH(w)}")
  write inbox-[:note]-> { body: "${JOIN(ranked, ",")}|${AT(SORT(words), 0)}|${total}|${COUNT(groups)}" }
}

inbox = email()

  pdfs = e-[a:Attachments WHERE a.Type = 'application/pdf']->.`File`
  docs = pdfs
  content = [e.`Subject`, ...docs]
}

the extraction keyword ('extract from […] { … }') is retired — an extraction is the call over a declared node shape: 'extract(content, Shape)' for each record the content holds, 'extractOne(content, Shape)' for the one it describes. The fix declares this tree as 'node MentionsShape' and writes 'mentions = extractOne(content, MentionsShape)': the one record the keyword's result was, its fields read off it and its nodes walked from it as before. Review it before applying: the record may be absent where the keyword's result never was (a field read off it then needs a fallback), an untyped field becomes <text>, and the model is asked through the call's prompt (see handbook: front#extraction)

import { email, attio } from adapters
import { acme_main } from credentials
import { fetchUrl as fetch_url } from plugins

inbox = connect email
crm = connect attio using acme_main
function intake(m: <inbox-[:message]->>) {
  all(
    () => { write crm-[:companies]-> { unique by (`name`), name: "Acme", summary: "left" } },
    () => { write crm-[:companies]-> { unique by (`name`), name: "Acme", summary: "right" } },
    () => { write crm-[:companies]-> { unique by (`name`), name: "Acme", summary: "third" } },
  )
}

import { email, attio } from adapters
import { acme_main } from credentials
import { fetchUrl as fetch_url, research, vcUrlRetrieval as vc_url_retrieval, linkedinEnrichment as linkedin_enrichment } from plugins

inbox = connect email
crm = connect attio using acme_main
function intake(m: <inbox-[:message]->>) {
  page = fetch_url(LOWER(m.`text`))
  shouted = fetch_url(UPPER(m.`text`))
}

}

import { email, attio } from adapters
import { acme_main } from credentials
import { fetch_url } from plugins

inbox = email()
crm = attio(credentials: acme_main)
movement intake(m: <inbox-[:message]->>) {
  files = COLLECT(m-[:files]->.data)
  content = [m.`subject`, ...files]
  await sleep(1h)
  write crm-[:companies]-> { name: COALESCE(READ(AT(content, 1)), "unread"), summary: COALESCE(READ(ONLY(files)), "unread") }
}

import { acme_main } from credentials
import { fetch_url, research, vc_url_retrieval, linkedin_enrichment } from plugins

inbox = email()
crm = attio(credentials: acme_main)
movement intake(m: <inbox-[:message]->>) {
  page = fetch_url(url: LOWER(m.`text`))
  shouted = fetch_url(url: UPPER(m.`text`))
}

import { email, attio } from adapters
import { dealflow_inbox, acme_main } from credentials

inbox = email(credentials: dealflow_inbox)
crm   = attio(credentials: acme_main)
movement intake(msg: <inbox-[:message]->>) {
  v = msg.`meta`
  n = COUNT(v-[:subs]->)
  ERROR("${n}")
}

import { email, attio, kg } from adapters
import { dealflow_inbox, acme_main, native_knowledge } from credentials

inbox = email(credentials: dealflow_inbox)
crm   = attio(credentials: acme_main)
graph = kg(credentials: native_knowledge)
movement main(msg: <inbox-[:message]->>) {
  r = await parallel([
    () => "one",
    () => 2,
  ])
  n = AT(r, 0)
}

import { email, attio, slack, affinity, dropbox, messaging, kg } from adapters
import { dealflow_inbox, acme_main, acme_second, acme_workspace, acme_affinity, team_drive, team_chat, native_knowledge } from credentials
import { scrubSensitive as scrub_sensitive, vcUrlRetrieval as vc_url_retrieval } from plugins

inbox = connect email using dealflow_inbox
crm   = connect attio using acme_main
team  = connect slack using acme_workspace
aff   = connect affinity using acme_affinity
drive = connect dropbox using team_drive
chan  = connect messaging using team_chat
graph = connect kg using native_knowledge
crm2 = connect attio using acme_second
function sync(co: <crm-[:company]->>) {
  …
}
function main(msg: <inbox-[:message]->>) {
  company = write crm2-[:companies]-> { name: msg.`subject` }
  sync(company)
}

diagnostics.message: 'sync' expects crm.company for 'co' (argument 1), but this argument is a crm2.company handle — these are two different systems: one is reached with the credential 'acme_main', the other with 'acme_second'

import { dealflow_inbox, acme_main, acme_workspace, acme_affinity, team_drive, team_chat, native_knowledge } from credentials
import { scrubSensitive as scrub_sensitive, vcUrlRetrieval as vc_url_retrieval } from plugins

inbox = connect email using dealflow_inbox
crm   = connect attio using acme_main
team  = connect slack using acme_workspace
aff   = connect affinity using acme_affinity
drive = connect dropbox using team_drive
chan  = connect messaging using team_chat
graph = connect kg using native_knowledge
function main(msg: <inbox-[:message]->>) {
  write crm-[:note]-> {
    unique by (`text`)
    text: @current_date
  }
}

diagnostics.message: 'main' has no listener, so nothing dispatches it — add a listen statement, e.g. listen to inbox fire main

Store the link explicitly, in the system that holds it: a field there that carries crm's identity, which the next write finds the record by ('write crm-[:Companies]-> { unique by (`Source Id`), `Source Id`: …, … }'), or an edge there. Then drop 'bind crm' (see handbook: front#identity)

import { dealflow_inbox, acme_main, acme_workspace, acme_affinity, team_drive, team_chat, native_knowledge } from credentials
import { scrubSensitive as scrub_sensitive, vcUrlRetrieval as vc_url_retrieval } from plugins

inbox = connect email using dealflow_inbox
crm   = connect attio using acme_main
team  = connect slack using acme_workspace
aff   = connect affinity using acme_affinity
drive = connect dropbox using team_drive
chan  = connect messaging using team_chat
graph = connect kg using native_knowledge
function main(msg: <inbox-[:message]->>) {
  write team-[:messages]-> { channel: "#d", text: msg-[:sender]->.domain }
}

diagnostics.message: 'main' has no listener, so nothing dispatches it — add a listen statement, e.g. listen to inbox fire main

import { dealflow_inbox, acme_main, acme_workspace, acme_affinity, team_drive, team_chat, native_knowledge } from credentials

}

diagnostics.message: 'bind msg' is retired — a write no longer keeps a hidden link to a record in another system, which no system could show or change. Store the link explicitly, in the system that holds it: a field there that carries msg's identity, which the next write finds the record by ('write crm-[:Companies]-> { unique by (`Source Id`), `Source Id`: …, … }'), or an edge there. Then drop 'bind msg' (see handbook: front#identity)
'main' has no listener, so nothing dispatches it — add a listen statement, e.g. listen to inbox fire main

import { email, attio, slack, affinity, dropbox, messaging, kg } from adapters
import { dealflow_inbox, acme_main, acme_workspace, acme_affinity, team_drive, team_chat, native_knowledge } from credentials
import { scrub_sensitive, vc_url_retrieval } from plugins

inbox = email(credentials: dealflow_inbox)
crm   = attio(credentials: acme_main)
team  = slack(credentials: acme_workspace)
aff   = affinity(credentials: acme_affinity)
drive = dropbox(credentials: team_drive)
chan  = messaging(credentials: team_chat)
graph = kg(credentials: native_knowledge)
movement main(msg: <inbox-[:message]->>) {
  co = write graph-[:companies]-> { name: "Acme" }
  write co-[:linked]-><person> { name: "Jane" }
}

import { email, attio, slack, affinity, dropbox, messaging, kg } from adapters
import { dealflow_inbox, acme_main, acme_workspace, acme_affinity, team_drive, team_chat, native_knowledge } from credentials
import { scrub_sensitive, vc_url_retrieval } from plugins

inbox = email(credentials: dealflow_inbox)
crm   = attio(credentials: acme_main)
team  = slack(credentials: acme_workspace)
aff   = affinity(credentials: acme_affinity)
drive = dropbox(credentials: team_drive)
chan  = messaging(credentials: team_chat)
graph = kg(credentials: native_knowledge)
movement main(msg: <inbox-[:message]->>) {
  co = write graph-[:companies]-> { unique by (`name`), name: msg.`subject` }
  write graph-[:deals]-> { name: msg.`subject`, company: co }
}

}

  msg-[f:files]-> {
    pieces = CHUNKS(READ(f.`data`), { size: 2000 })

}

import { email, attio, slack, kg } from adapters
import { dealflow_inbox, acme_main, acme_workspace, native_knowledge } from credentials
import { scrub_sensitive, vc_url_retrieval, fetch_url } from plugins

inbox = email(credentials: dealflow_inbox)
crm   = attio(credentials: acme_main)
team  = slack(credentials: acme_workspace)
graph = kg(credentials: native_knowledge)
movement m(msg: <inbox-[:message]->>) {
  prompt = msg.`subject`

import { team_drive, acme_main } from credentials

inbox = connect email
function intake(msg: <inbox-[:message]->>) {

}

import { email, graph, attio } from adapters
import { dealflow_inbox, acme_main } from credentials
inbox = connect email using dealflow_inbox
kg = connect graph
crm = connect attio using acme_main
function m(msg: <inbox-[:message]->>) {
  r = msg
  d = r.`meta`
  await sleep(1h)
  write crm-[:notes]-> { title: Json.stringify(d) }

}

The fix declares this tree as 'node DealsShape' and writes 'deals = extractOne(content, DealsShape)': the one record the keyword's result was, its fields read off it and its nodes walked from it as before. Review it before applying: the record may be absent where the keyword's result never was (a field read off it then needs a fallback), an untyped field becomes <text>, and the model is asked through the call's prompt (see handbook: front#extraction)

the extraction keyword ('extract from […] { … }') is retired — an extraction is the call over a declared node shape: 'extract(content, Shape)' for each record the content holds, 'extractOne(content, Shape)' for the one it describes. No rewrite keeps a 'through […]' stage's meaning: it hands each record's plugin answers to a further extraction of that record, merged into it, where a plugin called as a function hands back a value of its own. Rewrite it by hand: declare the shape, extract it, map over the records calling each plugin ('vc_url_retrieval()'), extractOne over the content plus what the plugin returned, and merge the two with a spread (see handbook: front#extraction)

}

source:
import { manual, kg } from adapters
import { kg_cred } from credentials
runs = manual()
graph = kg(credentials: kg_cred)
movement recap(go: <runs-[:Invocation]->>) {
  arms = []
  r = await race(arms)
}
listen to runs {} fire recap

diagnostics.message: 'await' marks where the run itself parks — a sleep, an until, an answer read — and 'race(…)' does not park by itself: its arms may, and the run parks where they do. Write 'race(…)' without 'await'

import { manual, kg } from adapters
import { kg_cred } from credentials
runs = manual()
graph = kg(credentials: kg_cred)
movement recap(go: <runs-[:Invocation]->>) {
  r = await parallel([
    () => { write graph-[:note]-> { body: "kept" } },
    () => { ERROR("second") },
    () => { ERROR("third") },
  ])
}
listen to runs {} fire recap

the extraction keyword ('extract from […] { … }') is retired — an extraction is the call over a declared node shape: 'extract(content, Shape)' for each record the content holds, 'extractOne(content, Shape)' for the one it describes. The fix declares this tree as 'node RShape' and writes 'r = extractOne(content, RShape)': the one record the keyword's result was, its fields read off it and its nodes walked from it as before. Review it before applying: the record may be absent where the keyword's result never was (a field read off it then needs a fallback), an untyped field becomes <text>, and the model is asked through the call's prompt (see handbook: front#extraction)

import { slack, drive } from adapters
chat = connect slack
docs = connect drive

function m(c: <chat-[:channel]->>) {
  cb = callback({ write chat-[:note]-> { Body: "x" } })
  t = Text.join(cb-[k:Called]->.`At`, ", ")
}
